claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_extradimensional_space
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's primary mechanic is creating a temporary extradimensional refuge that creatures can voluntarily enter and exit. No v4 atom covers this: transport_exile forces involuntary exile, container_storage is for item containers with carrying-capacity semantics, and block_travel/block_targeting have no anchor point to attach to since the space itself is what needs to be represented. A new atom is needed to model a spell-created extradimensional space with: a physical entry point (rope top), creature capacity (8 medium-or-smaller), bidirectional effect blocking (nothing passes in or out), and a timed duration.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the rope's upper end, an Invisible 3-foot-by-5-foot portal opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends. That space can be reached by climbing the rope. The space can hold up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. Attacks, spells, and other effects can't pass into or out of the space, but creatures inside it can see through the portal.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: block_travel / block_targeting scoped to a created space
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The blocking of attacks/spells/effects passing in or out of the space could reuse block_travel and block_targeting, but both atoms currently attach to a creature or area attachment. Rope Trick needs these to attach to the extradimensional space itself (a new attachment target), bidirectionally. This is a secondary widening that depends on the create_extradimensional_space atom being available first.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Attacks, spells, and other effects can't pass into or out of the space.
